newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Clayton Williams begun with hold. [corrected 21:56 gmt]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Clayton Williams begun with hold. [corrected 21:56 gmt]

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicaog Corp said Wednesday it initiated coverage on Clayton Williams Energy Inc with a hold rating.
-- Without an unexpected run-up in oil, the Midland, Texas-based oil and gas exploration company's market performance could be lackluster over the next several quarters, Chicago Corp said.
-- But a much heightened level of investor interest is anticipated as its Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef play heats up, Chicago Corp said.
-- "As a consequence, we feel positions should be initiated on price weakness and/or as we approach the fourth quarter," Chicago Corp analysts said in a research report.

-- Chicago Corp estimated 1997 cash flow (corrects from earnings to cash flow) for the company at $5.06 a share, compared to $5.19 a year ago. First quarter cash flow (corrects from earnings to cash flow) are estimated at $1.24 a share, up from $0.98 a share a year ago, ABN AMRO said.
